sentences.en: We are talking to you at about 12.30 on Thursday afternoon, and before we get into the details of why we are talking to you today, can you just tell me what has your day been like?
sentences.zh: 我们在周四下午大约12点30分采访您，在我们深入探讨今天采访您的原因之前，您能先讲讲您这一天是怎么度过的吗？

sentences.en: So I am an infectious disease doctor and I was the director for the National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases, and in the evening yesterday, I resigned.
sentences.zh: 我是一名传染病医生，曾任国家免疫和呼吸系统疾病中心主任，昨天晚上，我辞职了。

sentences.en: And so my morning has been about packing my office, dusting off the glass dust from the bullets that went through my window.

sentences.en: But dusting off the glass dust from my belongings, trying to pack as much as I can, and then ultimately, you know, having my access revoked at CDC
sentences.zh: 不过，就是拂去我物品上的玻璃灰尘，尽量多打包一些东西，然后最终，你知道的，我在疾控中心的权限被撤销了

sentences.en: and being escorted off the campus by folks who I work with very closely and who I love.

sentences.en: Or how did that work?

sentences.zh: 护送我们离开园区、撤销权限并收回我们的证件，这是恰当的做法。

sentences.en: And so I am no longer a CDC employee.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经不再是疾控中心的员工了。

sentences.en: And like I said, I was escorted off lovingly, but definitely escorted off the campus.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我是带着情谊被护送离开的，但确实是被护送离开了园区。

sentences.en: So as you said, you have resigned last night.
sentences.zh: 正如您所说，您昨晚辞职了。

sentences.en: That's why we're talking to you today.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天采访您的原因。

sentences.en: And the news also broke yesterday that the head of the CDC, Dr. Susan Menares, was basically fighting to keep her job amid this very public battle with Health Secretary Robert F.
sentences.zh: 昨天还爆出新闻，疾控中心负责人苏珊·梅纳雷斯博士为了保住工作，在一场与卫生部长小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪

sentences.en: And you and three other high-ranking officials left very publicly this week.
sentences.zh: 备受瞩目的公开斗争中进行抗争，而您和其他三位高层官员本周也公开离职了。

sentences.en: And so I am sort of curious.
sentences.zh: 所以我有点好奇。

sentences.en: You had said that you are director for immunizations, meaning that you are leading vaccine policy for the country.
sentences.zh: 您说过您是免疫部门的主任，这意味着您在领导全国的疫苗政策。

sentences.en: You've obviously been in the middle of a lot of controversy when it comes to his attempted firing and with RFK's leadership, his mandates, what he wants to begin with.
sentences.zh: 在小肯尼迪试图解雇您以及在他的领导、他的指令和他的初衷方面，您显然一直处于许多争议的漩涡中心。

sentences.en: So I guess the first thing I want to ask you is, can you give just a little bit of background about how you ended up at the CDC?
sentences.zh: 所以我想问您的第一件事是，您能简单介绍一下您是如何来到疾控中心的吗？

sentences.en: What were you doing there to begin with?
sentences.zh: 您最初在那里做什么？

sentences.en: What was your mandate?

sentences.en: I'm an infectious disease doctor.
sentences.zh: 我是一名传染病医生。

sentences.en: So I really started doing clinical work in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我最初是在纽约市开始从事临床工作的。

sentences.en: After doing a lot of work with the HIV Ending the Epidemic program in New York State, I was promoted to be the deputy commissioner for disease control.
sentences.zh: 在纽约州开展了大量“终结艾滋病流行”计划的工作后，我被晋升为疾病控制副局长。

sentences.en: And that's, in effect, the chief of infectious diseases for the New York City Department of Health.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这相当于纽约市卫生局的传染病主管。

sentences.en: I was in that role until November 2020.
sentences.zh: 我担任该职务直到2020年11月。

sentences.en: So I joined CDC to be the head of the Division of HIV-AIDS Prevention.
sentences.zh: 然后我加入疾控中心担任艾滋病毒/艾滋病预防司司长。

sentences.en: I was in that role for three months and then was pulled into the COVID-19 response, where I was in charge of the vaccine task force when the first boosters were coming out
sentences.zh: 我在那个岗位上干了三个月，接着被调去参与新冠肺炎应对工作，在第一批加强针推出时负责疫苗工作组

sentences.en: and was then asked to be the director for the National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases.
sentences.zh: 后来应邀担任国家免疫和呼吸系统疾病中心主任。

sentences.en: So I am your vaccine guy at CDC, along with Dan Jernigan, who actually focuses on the vaccine safety piece of vaccines.
sentences.zh: 所以我是疾控中心管疫苗的负责人，还有丹·杰尼根，他主要关注疫苗的安全问题。

sentences.en: So just to put it really simply, you have worked under both Democratic, Republican administrations, Biden, Trump.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，您曾在民主党和共和党政府手下都工作过，包括拜登和特朗普。

sentences.en: How long have you been at CDC, all told?
sentences.zh: 总算下来，您在疾控中心工作了多久？

sentences.en: About five years.
sentences.zh: 大约五年。

sentences.en: So I want to fast forward a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我想把时间稍微快进一下。

sentences.en: In late 2024, early 2025, Trump gets reelected.
sentences.zh: 在2024年底、2025年初，特朗普再次当选总统。

sentences.en: He takes office.
sentences.zh: 他上任了。

sentences.en: It's very clear that he was going to install RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他将任命小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪

sentences.en: as health secretary.
sentences.zh: 担任卫生部长。

sentences.en: What was your initial reaction to that?
sentences.zh: 您对此的第一反应是什么？

sentences.en: So, you know, maybe I'm a pathological optimist, but I, you know, I listened to the hearings.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，也许我是个病态的乐观主义者，但我听了听证会。

sentences.en: I, you know, watched them avidly.
sentences.zh: 我热切地关注了这些。

sentences.en: I took notes and said, how can we work within what we know is scientifically correct and clinically valid to be able to realize the vision of the secretary?
sentences.zh: 我当时做了笔记，并说，我们如何在科学上正确、临床上有效的前提下，去实现部长的愿景？

sentences.en: Like, we've been doing all this work to try to do that.
sentences.zh: 比如说，我们一直在做各种工作来试图做到这一点。

sentences.en: The thing that experts like the most is to share their expertise.
sentences.zh: 专家最喜欢做的事情就是分享他们的专业知识。

sentences.en: And we were all geared up to make sure that we let him know the deep information around the diseases that we cover
sentences.zh: 我们做好了充分准备，确保让他了解我们所涉及疾病的深入信息，

sentences.en: and the vaccines that we know have prevented so many bad outcomes in kids and adults.
sentences.zh: 以及我们深知的那些已在儿童和成人中防止了如此多不良后果的疫苗。

sentences.en: And even though we offered that to several of his executive staff, we've never been taken up on it.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们向他的几位高级幕僚提出了这一点，但从未得到采纳。

sentences.en: And we're going to get to all of that.
sentences.zh: 我们等会儿会讲到所有这些。

sentences.en: But Robert F.
sentences.zh: 但小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr.'s stance on vaccines was no secret.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪对疫苗的立场并不是什么秘密。

sentences.en: And so I just sort of wonder, what did you see that gave you hope that you would be able to communicate effectively
sentences.zh: 所以我有点好奇，你看到了什么让你怀有希望，认为自己能够有效地传达

sentences.en: what you believe the science to be and what you believe public policy should be?
sentences.zh: 你所认为的科学以及你所认为的公共政策应该是什么样的？

sentences.en: So like I said, I watched everything that the secretary was doing from when he was doing his confirmation hearings.
sentences.zh: 所以就像我说的，我观看了部长从提名听证会开始所做的一切。

sentences.en: And he said he was landing at HHS with no presupposed notions, no pre-decided ideas.
sentences.zh: 他说他来到卫生与公众服务部时没有先入为主的观念，也没有预先决定的想法。

sentences.en: And you believe that?
sentences.zh: 你相信那个吗？

sentences.en: I've worked under so many politicals that I have to believe it.
sentences.zh: 我在那么多政治任命官员手下工作过，我不得不相信它。

sentences.en: There's no choice but to believe it if you're going to do your job.
sentences.zh: 如果你想把工作做好，除了相信它别无选择。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, the American people have spoken.
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国人民已经发声了。

sentences.en: They voted for a president.
sentences.zh: 他们投票选出了一位总统。

sentences.en: And that president has installed a human into this position who he feels confident will support the health of people in the United States.
sentences.zh: 而这位总统在这个职位上安插了一个他认为有信心支持美国人民健康的人。

sentences.en: So you have to start from the point of how are we going to work with this to realize the vision while also making sure that vision understands the science.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须从这个出发点开始：我们如何与之合作来实现这一愿景，同时确保该愿景理解科学？

sentences.en: Can you give us an example of something early on that you were able to work with that you felt fell in line with your mission
sentences.zh: 你能给我们举个早期的例子吗？有什么事是你能参与并觉得符合你的使命的，

sentences.en: and perhaps the mission of Kennedy and of the CDC in that moment?
sentences.zh: 也许在那个时刻也符合肯尼迪和疾控中心的使命？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think that one of the great examples is sort of managing the measles outbreak in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我认为一个很好的例子就是处理德克萨斯州的麻疹疫情。

sentences.en: We definitely, you know, saw that there was some disparate messaging between sort of, you know, mainline public health and some of what the secretary said.
sentences.zh: 我们确实发现，主流公共卫生机构与部长所说的一些言论之间存在一些不同的传达。

sentences.en: And so I think that we worked really carefully to make sure that we, you know, reflected some of the secretary's vision or most of the secretary's vision
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们非常仔细地工作，确保我们在

sentences.en: into the communication that we made.
sentences.zh: 发布的沟通信息中反映了部长的部分愿景或大部分愿景。

sentences.en: So I'll give the example, you know, I traveled to the part of Texas where the outbreak was happening.
sentences.zh: 所以我举个例子，你知道的，我去了疫情爆发的德克萨斯州那个地方。

sentences.en: And when I went there, I learned from the providers as well as the community that if you always leave with vaccine in that community, it doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 当我到那里时，我从医疗服务提供者以及社区了解到，如果你在那个社区总是只推行疫苗，那是行不通的。

sentences.en: And so, you know, in Texas, one of the issues was that people didn't feel comfortable going to emergency rooms or didn't know what the signs were to take their kids to the ERs.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在德克萨斯州，问题之一是人们去急诊室感到不舒服，或者不知道带孩子去急诊室的迹象是什么。

sentences.en: And so what would happen is the kids would land very, very ill.
sentences.zh: 所以会发生的情况是，孩子们送到医院时已经病得非常非常重了。

sentences.en: And so we shifted the message from being like an only vaccine drumbeat to including vaccine
sentences.zh: 因此，我们改变了信息传达方式，不再仅仅是单一的疫苗催促，而是将疫苗

sentences.en: prominently, but also talking about what the signs were where you should get into your car and drive to Lubbock because it's an hour away.
sentences.zh: 放在显眼位置，同时也谈论哪些迹象表明你应该上车开车去拉巴克，因为那里只有一个小时车程。

sentences.en: I seem to remember at this moment, Kennedy got a lot of criticism for basically sending a message that people should get vaccines, but you should also be allowed to decide what
sentences.zh: 我依稀记得当时肯尼迪受到了很多批评，因为他基本上传达了这样一种信息：人们应该接种疫苗，但也应该允许自己决定

sentences.en: you want to do.
sentences.zh: 你想做什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, we really tried to do our best to meld sort of that piece of it into the guidance.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们确实尽最大努力将这部分内容融入到指导方针中。

sentences.en: So I mean, I think that that's what we do in government is really try to figure out a way to sort of achieve the vision while making sure that we're staying, you know, very close
sentences.zh: 所以我的意思是，我认为这就是我们在政府中所做的，真的是想方设法去实现愿景，同时确保我们

sentences.en: to the science.
sentences.zh: 非常紧贴科学。

sentences.zh: 你能跟我谈谈你是什么时候开始看到让你担心的事情的吗？

sentences.en: What were some of those early signs?
sentences.zh: 其中一些早期迹象是什么？

sentences.zh: 我认为最让我担心的是关于解雇或罢免免疫实践咨询委员会（ACIP）17名成员的舆论风向，理由是他们某种程度上因

sentences.en: And remind us quickly, ACIP, tell us.

sentences.zh: 它是免疫实践咨询委员会。

sentences.en: It's the body in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它是美国

sentences.en: housed at the CDC that advises the director of the CDC on vaccine policy.
sentences.zh: 设在疾控中心的机构，负责就疫苗政策向疾控中心主任提供咨询。

sentences.zh: 而你看到肯尼迪解雇了这个对制定和发布疫苗政策至关重要的组织中的成员。

sentences.en: People who are vetted, people who have scientific reputations around the country as being like the best and brightest in the area.
sentences.zh: 这些是经过严格审查的人，是在全国范围内享有科学声誉、被认为是该领域最优秀和最聪明的人。

sentences.en: And the narrative for why they were fired was around their conflicts of interest and the
sentences.zh: 他们被解雇的原因的舆论风向围绕着他们的利益冲突，以及

sentences.en: fact that this administration can't put their stamp on this committee fast enough to achieve the policy goals of the agency.
sentences.zh: 现届政府迫不及待地将这个委员会打上他们的印记以实现机构的政策目标这一事实。

sentences.en: Wait, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 等等，不好意思。

sentences.en: So the stated policies were what?
sentences.zh: 所以声明的政策是什么？

sentences.en: For firing them?
sentences.zh: 为了解雇他们？

sentences.en: That they did not fall in line with the administration?
sentences.zh: 因为他们不服从政府？

sentences.zh: 归根结底，我已经把我能为疾控中心和公共卫生付出的一切都奉献出来了。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I think it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 我经历了一段非常出色的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I held on for seven months despite some really wild times.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我真的觉得我对美国人民的价值已经到此为止了，因为我无法控制那些绝对会被玷污的科学。

sentences.en: I found that there was no path to doing good public health in the environment anymore.
sentences.zh: 显然，当许多人审视公共卫生和公共政策的现状时，他们目前所担忧的噩梦般的情景是，可能会爆发另一场大流行，而我们却没有合适的科学家来掌权，也没有制定出正确的政策。

sentences.en: And so I do wish them great luck in trying to execute the meeting without people who are able to guide them through the process.
sentences.zh: 并且基本上，将由科学以外的其他东西来决定我们的应对措施。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, I've given all that I can to CDC and to public health.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否也有这种特别的噩梦感。

sentences.en: I've had a really strong career.
sentences.zh: 我非常关切美国的公共卫生安全。

sentences.en: And, you know, I really feel like that my utility to the American people is done there because I'm not able to control what is absolutely going to be compromised science.
sentences.zh: 我关心个人的健康，但也非常担心科学家队伍的侵蚀，不仅是在疾控中心，在FDA、NIH，坦率地说，在学术界也是如此，

sentences.en: Obviously, the nightmare scenario that a lot of people right now are worried about when they look at the landscape of public health and public policy is that there could be another
sentences.zh: 伴随着针对这些资金的猛烈攻势，我们确实正在失去那些知道如何做好这项工作的人。

sentences.en: pandemic and we are not going to have the right scientists in charge and we're not going to have the right policies in charge.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为会出现一个真空期。

sentences.en: And that basically, something other than science will dictate our response.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你它什么时候会发生，但传染病总能找到可乘之机。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you share that particular nightmare.
sentences.zh: 而且我们对全球各地传染病蔓延情况的洞察力已经减弱了。

sentences.en: I'm very concerned about the public health security of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们曾经是该领域的领导者，而这已经结束了。

sentences.en: I'm concerned about the individual health of people, but also very concerned that the erosion of scientists, not only at CDC, but also at FDA, NIH, and frankly, in academia,
sentences.zh: 所以我担心像埃博拉这样的疾病，我们过去在疾控中心能够在传染源头阻止它们扩散，以免其对美国构成威胁。

sentences.en: with the aggressiveness that's happened toward that funding as well, that we really are losing the people who know how to do this.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不在那里，不知道发生了什么，可能直到它登陆我们的海岸，我们才知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: I do think that there's going to be a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 在你谈到的这些设景中，如果你已经离开了疾控中心，并且担心你所说的某种情况蔓延到我们的

sentences.en: I can't tell you when it's going to happen, but infectious diseases always find a way.
sentences.zh: 海岸，你，达斯卡拉基斯医生，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: And we have less visibility in what's happening with infectious diseases across the entire globe.
sentences.zh: 比如，为了公共卫生，你还有什么筹码可以动用？

sentences.en: We've been a leader in that space and that's ended.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我们今天谈论的疾控中心甚至已经不是两年前的那个疾控中心了。

sentences.en: And so I'm worried about things like Ebola, where we have been able at CDC to stop infections at their source before they cause a threat to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为要想发挥作用，目前待在联邦公共卫生机构并不是最好的去处。

sentences.en: If we're not there, don't know what's going on, it may not be until it lands on our shores that we know what's happening.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我认为非常需要一些了解内情且无所畏惧的拥护者。

sentences.en: In the scenarios that you're talking about, like, what do you do, you, Dr. Daskalakis, do if you've left the CDC and you're worried about something, as you said, coming onto our
sentences.zh: 我希望，你知道的，拉响警报能让决策者、政府官员真正明白情况极其严重。

sentences.en: shores?
sentences.zh: 同时，我认为让美国公众知道他们确实需要对听到来自ACIP的建议保持谨慎也是很重要的，考虑到我们正在告诉你们的这些。

sentences.en: Like, what lever is there for you to pull for public health?
sentences.zh: 等等，为了确保我没听错，你是说美国现在的人民应该对这个被委以保护他们安全的机构所提供的建议保持警惕吗？

sentences.en: So, you know, the CDC that we're talking about today is not the CDC of even two years ago.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so I don't think that the place to be currently is in federal public health to be effective.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对于一个刚刚离开疾控中心的人来说，这番话是非常非同寻常的。

sentences.en: So, you know, I think that the need for some fearless advocates who know the inside is necessary.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普第二任期的这个节点上，我们听说过太多离开政府岗位的人。

sentences.en: And I hope that, you know, lifting the red flag so folks who are policymakers, folks in government really understand that there's something extremely wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们都是资深的公务员。

sentences.en: And also, I think it's important for the American public to know that they really need to be cautious
sentences.zh: 他们或许正在私营部门或非营利部门尝试发展。

sentences.en: about the recommendations that they're hearing coming out of ACIP, given what we're telling you.
sentences.zh: 关于他们听到的来自ACIP的建议，鉴于我们告诉你的情况。

sentences.en: Wait, just so I'm clear, you're saying that the American people should now be wary of the advice they get from the agency that is tasked with keeping them safe?
sentences.zh: 等等，为了确保我没听错，你是说美国人民现在应该对负责保护他们安全的机构所提供的建议保持警惕吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
I feel like that is an extraordinary thing for a person who has just left the CDC to say.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对于一个刚离开疾控中心的人来说，说出这样的话真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And at this point in the second Trump administration, we have heard of so many people who have left their posts in government.
sentences.zh: 而在特朗普第二政府的这个阶段，我们已经听说有那么多的人离开了他们在政府的职位。

sentences.en: These are longtime civil servants.
sentences.zh: 这些人都是长期的公务员。

sentences.en: They're maybe trying their hand at the private sector or nonprofit sector.
sentences.zh: 他们可能正在尝试进入私营部门或非营利部门。

sentences.en: And I guess I'm curious about just more broadly how you think of the role of the federal government in this moment and the function of government going forward.
sentences.zh: 而且我想我更广泛地好奇，你如何看待当前联邦政府的角色以及未来政府的职能。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know what the future is because it's not been expressed.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道未来会怎样，因为目前还没有表达出来。

sentences.en: I have a lot of slogans that I'm hearing from HHS, but not a lot of vision of what actually happens with public health.
sentences.zh: 我听到卫生与公众服务部（HHS）有很多口号，但对于公共卫生究竟会发生什么，却没有什么愿景。

sentences.en: Wait, I have to ask you about these slogans, though, because everything you're saying, if you're saying
sentences.zh: 等等，我不得不问你关于这些口号的事情，因为你所说的一切，如果你在说

sentences.en: don't trust what you're hearing from the federal agencies, is one of those slogans, do your own research?
sentences.zh: 不要相信你从联邦机构听到的东西，其中一个口号是“自己做研究”吗？

sentences.en: And is that what you think at this point?
sentences.zh: 这就是你目前的想法吗？

sentences.en: Because you're telling people don't listen to the officials.
sentences.zh: 因为你在告诉人们不要听从官员的话。

sentences.en: I think that at this point, you should ask your doctor, like, what the interpretation is.
sentences.zh: 我认为在这一点上，你应该问你的医生，比如，这到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: Look at what professional organizations that represent the doctors and providers that you trust,
sentences.zh: 看看代表你信任的医生和医疗提供者的专业组织，

sentences.en: what they're recommending, and really question what's happening sort of on the federal level because of undue influence and directives that are not transparent.
sentences.zh: 看看他们的建议，并真正质疑由于不当影响和不透明的指令，联邦层面上到底在发生什么。

sentences.en: So radical transparency,
sentences.zh: 所以彻底的透明度，

sentences.en: I've not seen any of that.
sentences.zh: 我一点也没看到。

sentences.en: Gold standard science, not seen any of that either.
sentences.zh: 黄金标准科学，我也一点没看到。

sentences.en: And so these are the things that I hear that to me are code for it's my way or the highway.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是我听到的事情，对我来说，它们其实就是“不听我的就走人”的代名词。

sentences.en: And so that is not the way public health works, and that's not the way science works.
sentences.zh: 这不是公共卫生运作的方式，也不是科学运作的方式。

sentences.en: When you resigned, you wrote a very strongly worded letter, and I want to read you a paragraph from it.
sentences.zh: 你辞职时写了一封措辞非常严厉的信，我想读给你听其中的一段。

sentences.en: You said, public health is not merely about the health of the individual, but it is about the health of the community, the nation, and the world.
sentences.zh: 你说，公共卫生不仅关乎个人的健康，更关乎社区、国家乃至世界的健康。

sentences.en: The nation's health security is at risk and is in the hands of people focusing on ideological self-intereSt.
sentences.zh: 国家的健康安全正处于危险之中，并且掌握在那些只关注意识形态私利的人手中。

sentences.en: And I would just like you to reflect on how that holds up to the idea that you mentioned earlier
sentences.zh: 我只是想请你反思一下，这与你之前提到的观点如何契合，

sentences.en: that the best way people can keep themselves safe right now is to talk to their doctor.
sentences.zh: 即目前人们保护自己安全的最有效方式是与他们的医生沟通。

sentences.en: How did it feel to write that publicly?
sentences.zh: 公开写下那封信是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I've never been one to hold back in my entire career.
sentences.zh: 我整个职业生涯都从不遮遮掩掩。

sentences.en: It felt like the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 感觉这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: It felt hard.
sentences.zh: 这感觉很艰难。

sentences.en: But I made a promise when I became a doctor, and I made a promise when I went to CDC that I would make sure that I work to improve the health of people.
sentences.zh: 但当我成为一名医生时我曾许下诺言，当我加入疾控中心（CDC）时我也许下诺言，我会确保自己致力于改善人们的健康。

sentences.en: And so it's my job, as a clinician, as a physician, and a public health professional, to really make sure that folks know what's happening.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一名临床医生、内科医生和公共卫生专业人员，我的职责就是确保大家了解正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so I felt very stressed by writing it.
sentences.zh: 所以写下它让我感到压力很大。

sentences.en: I don't want to put myself up for attack because I'm sure I'm going to get it.
sentences.zh: 我不想让自己成为攻击的目标，因为我确信这免不了。

sentences.en: But I am very, very worried about the safety of our country and our health.
sentences.zh: 但我非常非常担心我们国家的安全和健康。

sentences.en: And I have to say it out loud.
sentences.zh: 我必须大声说出来。

sentences.en: I think that the data is going to be compromised.
sentences.zh: 我认为数据将会被妥协。

sentences.en: The science is not going to be the science.
sentences.zh: 科学将不再是真正的科学。

sentences.en: It's going to be some Frankenstein of science and ideology.
sentences.zh: 它将成为科学与意识形态的某种弗兰肯斯坦式的怪胎。

sentences.en: Whose reaction were you worried about the most when they learned about your resignation?
sentences.zh: 当你得知辞职消息时，你最担心谁的反应？

sentences.en: My husband's.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫的。

sentences.en: That's going to cause all sorts of backlash given our current environment.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们当前的环境，这会引起各种各样的强烈反对。

sentences.en: I've already gotten a bunch of homophobic comments on my social media.
sentences.zh: 我的社交媒体上已经收到了很多同性恋恐惧症的言论。

sentences.en: And so I imagine that will just make it worse.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜这只会让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: But that's the truth.
sentences.zh: 但这是事实。

sentences.en: I moved my husband to Atlanta so that I could be at the CDC.
sentences.zh: 我把丈夫搬到了亚特兰大，这样我就可以在疾控中心工作。

sentences.en: I wish I could say it was some academic or other public health person.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能说是某个学术界人士或其他公共卫生人员。

sentences.en: But, you know, my family matters firSt.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我的家人永远是第一位的。

sentences.en: What has he said to you so far about your decision to leave?
sentences.zh: 关于你离开的决定，他到目前为止对你说了什么？

sentences.en: It all worked out okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都还好。

sentences.en: He knows that the time had come for me.
sentences.zh: 他知道我离开的时机已经成熟了。
